Metadata.title: Gabriel Hono · Portfolio
Metadata.description: Web developer, theater artist and sound technician. Discover Gabriel Hono’s work.

Home.intro: Hi! I’m Gabriel, I live and work in Paris, and these are my main disciplines:

dev.label: web development
dev.hover: Full-stack web developer: TypeScript, React, Next.js, Express.

theater.label: theater / performance
theater.hover: Actor, director and producer. Theater and the arts are my way of understanding human experience.

sound.label: sound
sound.hover: Sound technician for film, concerts and art installations.

about.title: about me
about.p1: I grew up in Chile and moved to France at 27, without any big reason: I just wanted to start a new life.
about.p2: I don’t believe in fixed identities, which may explain my multidisciplinary path. I’m transmasc and I love it. I studied theater; steady gigs were rare, but I never stopped creating.
about.p3: In France I became a sound technician for concerts, film and exhibitions. Then I trained as a full-stack developer at Ada Tech School. And here I am, making a life out of all of them :)

contact.title: let’s talk!
contact.text: Have a project in mind where I could help? Fill in the form and let’s talk :)
